title: Lysine-Cysteine-Serine-Tryptophan Inserted into the DNA-Binding Domain of Human Mineralocorticoid Receptor Increases Transcriptional Activation by Aldosterone
authors: Yoshinao Katsu; Jiawen Zhang; Michael E. Baker
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人盐皮质激素受体DBD中KCSW插入对醛固酮转录激活的影响，涉及TF-DNA结合域变异但无AI/物理模拟方法，仅细胞实验，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Due to alternative splicing in an ancestral DNA-binding domain (DBD) of the mineralocorticoid receptor (MR), humans contain two almost identical MR transcripts with either 984 amino acids (MR-984) or 988 amino acids (MR-988), in which their DBDs differ by only four amino acids, Lys,Cys,Ser,Trp (KCSW). Human MRs also contain mutations at two sites, codons 180 and 241, in the amino terminal domain (NTD). Together, there are five distinct full-length human MR genes in GenBank. Human MR-984, which was cloned in 1987, has been extensively studied. Human MR-988, cloned in 1995, contains KCSW in its DBD. Neither this human MR-988 nor the other human MR-988 genes have been studied for their response to aldosterone and other corticosteroids. Here, we report that transcriptional activation of human MR-988 by aldosterone is increased by about 50% compared to activation of human MR-984 in HEK293 cells transfected with the TAT3 promoter, while the half-maximal response (EC50) is similar for aldosterone activation of MR-984 and MR-988. Transcriptional activation of human MR also depends on the amino acids at codons 180 and 241. Interestingly, in HEK293 cells transfected with the MMTV promoter, transcriptional activation by aldosterone of human MR-988 is similar to activation of human MR-984, indicating that the promoter has a role in the regulation of the response of human MR-988 to aldosterone. The physiological responses to aldosterone and other corticosteroids in humans with MR genes containing KCSW and with differences at codons 180 and 241 in the NTD warrant investigation.
abstract_zh: 由于盐皮质激素受体（MR）祖先DNA结合域（DBD）的选择性剪接，人类含有两种几乎相同的MR转录本，分别编码984个氨基酸（MR-984）或988个氨基酸（MR-988），其DBD仅相差四个氨基酸，即赖氨酸、半胱氨酸、丝氨酸、色氨酸（KCSW）。人类MR在氨基末端域（NTD）的180和241密码子位点也存在突变。总体而言，GenBank中有五种不同的全长人类MR基因。1987年克隆的人类MR-984已被广泛研究。1995年克隆的人类MR-988在其DBD中含有KCSW。无论是这种人类MR-988还是其他人类MR-988基因，均未研究其对醛固酮和其他皮质类固醇的反应。在此，我们报告，在转染TAT3启动子的HEK293细胞中，醛固酮对人类MR-988的转录激活比人类MR-984的激活增加约50%，而醛固酮激活MR-984和MR-988的半最大响应（EC50）相似。人类MR的转录激活还取决于180和241密码子的氨基酸。有趣的是，在转染MMTV启动子的HEK293细胞中，醛固酮对人类MR-988的转录激活与人类MR-984的激活相似，表明启动子在调节人类MR-988对醛固酮的反应中发挥作用。对于含有KCSW的MR基因及NTD中180和241密码子差异的人类个体，其对醛固酮和其他皮质类固醇的生理反应值得进一步研究。
